description: This file defines an abstract Scala class 'ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter' that extends 'LoggingAdapter' and provides additional thread-safe logging functionalities, such as setting, deriving, and removing correlation IDs for log entries within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract thread-safe logging adapter that extends Akka's LoggingAdapter to include MDC-based correlation ID management, supporting thread safety and flexible correlation ID setting and removal.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the given correlation ID for subsequent log entries, returning a new logger instance that appends this ID to all log operations.

methods.name: withCorrelationId (overloaded with WithDittoHeaders)
methods.description: Derives and sets the correlation ID from provided WithDittoHeaders object, returning a logger with the derived ID.

methods.name: withCorrelationId (overloaded with DittoHeaders)
methods.description: Extracts the correlation ID from DittoHeaders object and sets it for log operations, returning an updated logger.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the current correlation ID from the MDC, returning a logger instance without any correlation ID.
